Des handicaps invisibles, qui peuvent aboutir à un échec scolaire massif et à une grande souffrance morale s’ils ne sont pas bien pris en charge. Pour comprendre à quel point ces troubles occupent une place importante dans la vie des enfants qui en sont atteints, Fred va rencontrer de jeunes patients et les adultes impliqués dans leur accompagnement. Jamy, lui, va installer son laboratoire au Neurospin, un centre de référence en imagerie cérébrale près de Paris, où l’on étudie notamment le fonctionnement du cerveau des personnes «dys».

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Depuis l’accident de la centrale nucléaire de Fukushima au Japon en mars 2011, de nombreuses questions se posent sur la sûreté des installations nucléaires. Si un tel accident devait se produire en France, que se passerait-il ? De quels moyens dispose EDF pour faire face à une telle catastrophe ? Comment protéger la population ? Quelles seraient les conséquences à long terme d'un tel accident ? Pour mener l’enquête, Fred va suivre un exercice de crise à la centrale de Cruas-Meysse en Ardèche. Jamy quant à lui va s’installer à l’IRSN, l’Institut de radioprotection et de sûreté nucléaire.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: En 2010, les accidents de la route ont fait 3992 tués et à peu près autant de personnes handicapées lourdement. Un grand nombre de ces drames ont lieu sur des trajets quotidiens ou dans des situations apparemment sans risque. Sur la route, nous sommes tous convaincus d'être de bons conducteurs et nous sous estimons l’imprévu et ses dangers. L'objectif de la Sécurité Routière est de descendre en dessous des 3000 morts dès 2012. Fred a suivi un escadron de la gendarmerie nationale des Yvelines et les « vététistes » de la Préfecture de Police de Paris. Jamy lui s’est installé à l'UTAC (Union technique de l'Automobile, du motocycle et du Cycle), un centre spécialisée dans les essais de véhicules et d’équipements où sont réalisés de nombreux crash tests.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Noël est l'occasion d'une véritable ruée sur les jouets. A travers ses rencontres Fred va nous dévoiler quels sont les jeux les plus en vogues, les normes drastiques auxquelles ils sont soumis avant leur mise sur le marché et pourquoi ils sont si importants dans la vie d'un enfant. Jamy va s'installer dans un grand magasin ouvert pour lui tout seul et va nous décortiquer l'univers du jouet.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans les années 60, de plus en plus de Français peuvent s'offrir une voiture. C'est une révolution ! En 10 ans, on passe de 5 à 12 millions de véhicules. On peut désormais aller où on veut et quand on veut ! Mais cinquante ans plus tard... c'est l'asphyxie ! Les villes s'étranglent sous la pollution et les bouchons. A l'occasion de la journée "Bougez autrement", Fred et Jamy explorent la ville de Lyon et ses transports en commun et s'interrogent sur l'avenir de ce trafic devenu incessant.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le printemps, c'est la saison du renouveau. Après de longs mois de repos, la nature reprend vie. C'est le soleil qui va donner le signal de la sortie de l'hiver. Les perce-neiges sortent de terre, les premiers bourgeons apparaissent, les insectes reprennent vie... et les hirondelles annoncent la saison nouvelle. Fred et Jamy nous expliquent les petits miracles de cette saison foisonnante qu'est le printemps. Entre forêts, vergers et potagers, ils nous entraînent dans une jolie promenade pour découvrir avec nous les bouleversements qui se succèdent.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les coraux ne sont ni des végétaux, ni de simples cailloux décoratifs… mais de minuscules animaux - des polypes - qui, pour la plupart, vivent en colonies de milliers d'individus. Ces lointains cousins de l'anémone et de la méduse doivent leur survie à une association avec une micro-algue à laquelle ils offrent protection et nourriture, et qui en échange leur fournit les nutriments essentiels à leur survie. Que cette fragile petite algue disparaisse... et les coraux se mettent à dépérir. Fred et Jamy sont partie en Nouvelle-Calédonie pour découvrir avec nous l'étonnante biologie de ces mystérieuses petites bêtes marines. Mission Les coraux les plus connus sont les coraux constructeurs : de générations en générations, ils édifient un squelette externe qui finit par former une véritable muraille sous-marine. Mais il en existe beaucoup d'autres ! Accompagné d'une spécialiste du corail - Claire Goiran - Fred plonge à la découverte des milliers d'espèces de ces animaux étranges qui se cachent sous les eaux de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Il nous explique comment ils vivent, chassent et se reproduisent.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: D'où vient le vent ? Qu'est-ce que c'est un nuage ? Comment se transforment-ils parfois en pluie ? Pourquoi les dépressions et les anticyclones influencent-ils la météo ? Et comment peut-on prévoir le temps qu'il fera demain ? Sabine et Jamy nous expliquent tout des caprices du ciel. Nous partons avec eux explorer les 10 kilomètres de troposphère dans lesquels les masses d'air circulent sans cesse, faisant et défaisant la pluie et le beau temps.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent à la découverte des loups du Gévaudan. Ils nous ouvrent les portes du parc Sainte Lucie qui abrite 30 loups de Mongolie en semi-liberté.Les loups sont des animaux sociaux dont la vie est extrêmement codifiée. Nous apprenons comment ils chassent, communiquent et se reproduisent. Quelle est la répartition géographique des loups aujourd’hui ? Quelles règles sociales régissent la vie des loups ? Comment s’organisent leurs territoires ? Pourquoi loups et chiens ont-ils l’odorat si développé ? Quel rôle le loup joue-t-il dans la chaîne de prédation ? Qu’est-ce qui rapproche le chien

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Jamy a transformé le camion en atelier d'artiste : il veut devenir peintre ! Pour aider son compagnon de route, Fred part à la rencontre de spécialistes qui nous dévoilent de petites choses essentielles sur les couleurs, les supports, les techniques de perspectives et les jeux de lumière... Pourquoi prépare-t-on les toiles ? Quels sont les pigments et les matériaux utilisés dans la fabrication de la peinture ? Quelles sont les différences entre l'aquarelle et la peinture à l'huile ? Comment peut-on donner un effet de profondeur et de relief à son tableau ?

programme.title: Nature Time
programme.desc: Il est temps de se rapprocher de la nature. Appréciée par tous, tous âges et tous niveaux, NatureTime est une chaîne de streaming gratuite qui propose des histoires captivantes sur la faune et la nature du monde entier.

programme.desc: The all-time female money leader on the WPT, JJ Liu, returns to Los Angeles.

programme.title: World Poker Tour
programme.desc: The WPT hits the beach and the fun doesn’t stop until one player walks away a WPT champion.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The role of the wife is explored.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former guests who clashed over what defines a "good wife" return.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The hot topic of what defines a "good wife" is debated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping 2-part series, a mother seeks help for her pregnant, drug-using teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping 2-part series, Dr. Phil continues a drug intervention with an 18-year-old pregnant teen and her 20-year-sister.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two of this series, Rheta says her deceitful, backstabbing, meddling mother-in-law, Deb, is going to destroy her marriage if her husband, Mark, doesn't cut the cord. Rheta says she's so fed up with their mother-and-son bond that she's filed for divorce, shredded her wedding vows and has even come to blows with Deb on several occasions. Mark agrees that his mother is too involved, but can he break ties while Deb holds the purse strings? Does paying the couple's rent and providing them with a car give Deb license to criticize Rheta and try to set Mark up with other women? Rheta says that on some days, she and Mark are best friends, but their arguments get so heated that they've turned physical -- in front of their three children. Will a grand gesture from Mark keep Rheta from walking away? Can Rheta and Deb mend fences?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three friends confront former friend, Sarah, who faked terminal cancer, miscarriages, and used a wheelchair to pretend she had muscular dystrophy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two, will accused liar Sarah, who fibbed about having cancer, miscarriage and muscular dystrophy, change her ways?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother says her teen daughter is aggressive, violent and a bully who crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil wants a violent teen to meet someone who could change her life. How will she react?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman accuses a former friend of fake pregnancies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did a woman accused of fake pregnancies really lie?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A concerned daughter seeks Dr. Phil’s help to rescue her mother from a deceptive online relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A concerned daughter seeks Dr. Phil’s help to rescue her mother from a deceptive online relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she is worried that her 38-year-old brother-in-law Kevin may be having an inappropriate relationship with her 16-year-old daughter, Grace. Bridget says red flags went up when Grace told her that Kevin put whipped cream on his neck and asked her to lick it off, and then found a letter from Kevin hidden in Grace’s bedroom. Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Autumn claims her ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, abused her, which he denies. Why does she defend him to her parents?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with D’Andre, who blames his abusive relationship with his ex-girlfriend, Autumn, on her upbringing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.desc: Dr. Phil joins NYC Mayor Eric Adams on an evening tour of Herald Square and West 4th Street subway stations to explore the PATH initiative, which offers resources to help homeless and mentally ill individuals transition off the streets.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of missing Stacy Peterson is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The children of Drew Peterson deal with the reality of their father's suspected involvement in their mother's murder and stepmother's disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.desc: A husband wants his wife to shut down her You Tube channel and focus in their marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Trisha, a mother and wife, who is live streaming her entire life. Trisha claims she’s been bullied and harassed by her online “haters.” But Wendy, one of the women Trisha calls a “hater,” says it’s Trisha who has ruined people’s lives by live streaming their personal information, making negative comments about their appearance, and even claiming they are convicts. Find out what caused Trisha to storm off and collapse on stage. And, why did Dr. Phil almost have to call the paramedics?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

She claims to have already joined a gang, gotten pregnant and hit a teacher. Everyone, even Madisen, agrees she is troubled, but why does Dr. Phil say it would’ve been a bigger surprise if she didn't turn out this way? Did her father really try to forfeit his parental rights? And did her mother turn a blind eye to so many red flags? Learn why Dr. Phil believes it’s not too late for this teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Madisen first appeared on Dr. Phil her family had reached a breaking point with her defiant and outrageous behavior. Months later, after completing her program at a residential treatment facility for troubled teens, Madisen returns to the Dr. Phil stage to show off her amazing transformation. The 15-year-old says she’s ready to return home, but is home ready for her?

programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Catch the collegiate pickleball excitement from Week 2, Day 2 of the NCPA Utah Regional 2025. This intense team match features Utah Tech taking on Utah State as they compete for a national bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri.The episode features commentary on the exploding growth of college pickleball with college legend and Yola's College Relationship Manager, Timber Tucker. Watch key matchups in men's doubles, women's singles, and the deciding mixed doubles games. Key players include Gavin Fowler (singles 5.2 rating) , Brinley Horton , and Bo Cavell from Utah Tech, as well as standout players Olivia and Brady.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: It's Bobbi Oshiro and Megan Fudge versus Mari Humberg and Martina Frantova in a Women's Pro Doubles match at the US Open Pickleball Championships 2023.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Boca Raton Picklers face off against the Oklahoma City Punishers in a men's match from June 2024.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: In Week 4 of Season 2, the Arizona Pickleball League brings another exciting Tuesday night match at The Orchard. This week, the Peoria Pythons take on the Surprise Stingers, with thrilling moments and intense competition. Featuring standout players like Ryan Trefry, Lauren Mercado, Michael Lloyd, and Nico Montoya, the teams face off in a high-energy battle. From dynamic mixed doubles to powerful gender doubles, every set and game keeps viewers at the edge of their seats. Will the Pythons maintain their momentum, or will the Stingers make a dramatic comeback? Don’t miss this action-packed match full of strategy, drama, and plenty of pickleball!

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Sheri Courter and Christine Karges take on Sarah Mitten and Mary Helen Atkins in this Women's Senior Pro Quarterfinal Match.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League (WPBL) continues on Day 5 at the CCI Brabourne Stadium with a clash between Mumbai Pickle Power and the Chennai Super Champs.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: April 11, 2023 - the Tempe Tornadoes and Scottsdale Scorchers go at it in a sizzling hot match - live at The Orchard!

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: Experience the exciting Women's Doubles Open 4.5+ Final from the 2023 English Open held at Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. This match features dynamic teams: Megan Fudge and Susannah Barr face off against Lee Whitwell and Riley Bohnert in a highly competitive final. Follow expert commentary highlighting key plays including Susannah Barr’s precise lobs, Megan Fudge’s powerful forehand, and strategic teamwork. See how the match unfolds in a best-of-three games format with a hard stop on time. This showcase of top-level English pickleball captures the skill, tactics, and intensity of the sport. Stay tuned for post-match insights and upcoming mixed doubles action.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Championship Sunday at the NCPA Utah Regional 2025. This Round of 16 Collegiate Team Match pits the 5th-seeded Utah Tech against the 12th-seeded, but formidable, Utah State squad. The action takes place at Club Pickleball USA in Orem, Utah. Both teams are competing for a coveted bid to the National Championship in Saint Louis, Missouri, which features a $30,000 prize pool.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: Miami Blaze face off against St Pete Icebergs in a pickleball match at Epic Athletic Club.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Leigh Waters and Anna Leigh Waters take on Parris Todd and Yana Newell in this Women's Pro Doubles Semifinal Match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's Super Sunday on Day 3 of the World Pickleball League (WPL) as Game Number Five pits the Chennai Super Champs against the Delhi team (Dilwale) at the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai. The stakes are incredibly high as teams battle for the final semi-final spots.The action starts with the First Mixed Doubles match, featuring Chennai's coach, the legendary pro Joey Farias, teaming up with Anna Clarice. They face the formidable duo of Delhi's Willie Chung and Lauren Mercado. The match is a tactical masterclass, with Willie Chung noted for his consistent, pro-level reset game and Farias praised for his on-court intelligence.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: Tuesday Night Pickleball heats up as the Surprise Stingers go head-to-head with the Scottsdale Scorchers at The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health. Expect fiery team chemistry, quick-paced exchanges, and a crowd-ready atmosphere in this Arizona Pickleball League showdown.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Simone Jardim and Megan Fudge compete in this Women's Pro Singles match at the US Open Championships 2023.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: October 28, 2023 - It's the English Nationals Open in the Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. Teams face off to compete for victory!

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this fierce "Commonwealth Clash" features Virginia Tech taking on their in-state rivals, the University of Virginia (UVA). This pivotal pool play match is part of the fourth regional of the season, with teams vying for crucial seeding and a bid to the National Championship.The episode showcases intense action, starting with Women's Doubles, where UVA's Armelle Worrell and Mia Kim face off against Virginia Tech's Amelia Gaze and Heather Murphy. Later, watch the high-stakes Men's Singles match between Virginia Tech's Cody Miller, known for his reach and strategic placement, and UVA's Braden Cizek, who fights to keep his team in the series. With Virginia Tech leading 3-1 entering the singles match, every point counts.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: October 24, 2023 - Welcome to week 5 - season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Gilbert Gladiators face-off against the Peoria Pythons.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The pressure reaches a boiling point in Game 6 as Virginia Tech enters a must-win situation to keep their championship hopes alive against a dominant Ohio State squad. This episode showcases the high-speed "racing" volleys and technical "skills" of the Buckeyes as they ignite a massive scoring heater to take an early commanding lead. Not to be outdone, the Hokies demonstrate their "freestyle" resilience with powerful put-aways and a scrappy defensive effort to counter the Buckeye momentum. With special guest Michael McDonald providing expert analysis from the booth, every point becomes a tactical battle for collegiate pickleball supremacy.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: In this alternate cut of the Women’s Split Pro Doubles Quarterfinal at the 2024 US Open, Suzanne Leblang & Milan Rane face off against Martina Frantova & Christine Karges in a battle of shot placement, net pressure, and quick resets. Filmed in Naples, Florida, this matchup delivers a new perspective on one of the tournament’s most tactical and fast-paced doubles clashes.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Lee Whitwell and Andrei Daescu take on Patrick Cote and Susannah Barr in this Mixed Pro Split Age Quarterfinal.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and James Johnson take on Andrei Daescu and Gabriel Tardio in this Men's Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Golden Tate and Eric Decker.
